plan.notes: Official USM archived 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog, Criminology B.A. The catalog publishes major requirements (36 credits: 24 required + 12 electives) plus a year-level curriculum guide, but no official semester-by-semester sequence — collected as a single requirements block per coordinator 2026-10-09 convention. The year guide (Year 1: CRM 100, CRM 225; Year 2: CRM 216, CRM 220; Year 3: CRM 365, CRM 317 + electives; Year 4: CRM 310, CRM 402 + electives) is summarized here for reference. The 12-credit elective block (any four courses from the catalog list) is recorded as a single block per wave38 Brevard precedent; CRM 390 (1-15 cr) and CRM 395 (3-6 cr) carry variable credits and are noted in the choice note. University Core curriculum requirements are separate from the 36 major credits.
